what: A real run of the Lantern story on a local Midnight chain: every accepted step is a proved, balanced, finalized transaction.

flavour.what: contracts/src/lantern.compact with exactly one line changed, so the timelock can be waited out

payer: per step: the recovering phone holds no wallet and a sponsor paid its fees; Seo-yeon paid for the open; the genesis wallet paid the rest

host.name: LanternHost (unchanged)
host.committee: three Jubjub keys generated for this run; quorum 2

timingNotes: seconds. execute: the circuit run locally; prove: the local proof server; balance: adding DUST; submit: until the node included the transaction in a block (about 6 s per block); finalize: until midnight-js saw it finalized. The first proof of a run is marked cold.

steps.say: Hana enrols: a commitment to her identity secret, a commitment to a separate veto secret, threshold 2.
Hana adds Seo-yeon as a guardian. The leaf is public; the secret inside it went to Seo-yeon out of band.
Hana adds Mum as a guardian. The leaf is public; the secret inside it went to Mum out of band.
Hana adds Jihoon as a guardian. The leaf is public; the secret inside it went to Jihoon out of band.
She splits her identity secret 2-of-3 and gives each guardian one share. The veto card goes in a drawer.
Elsewhere on the same contract, Minji enrols an identity of her own.
She makes herself one of her own guardians, so she holds a real leaf with a real Merkle path.
An independent DApp, deployed separately, cannot read Lantern. It trusts a three-member committee, which rebuilds the list of current owners from Lantern's public ledger.
Member 1 proposes that root as epoch 0.
Member 1 signs it. The circuit verifies the Jubjub Schnorr signature itself.
Member 2 signs it. The circuit verifies the Jubjub Schnorr signature itself.
Two of three: epoch 0 is sealed.
The DApp stores one value, Hana's identity root, and asks: is the caller its current owner? Yes.
The independent DApp asks the same question of the committee's latest epoch, with a Merkle path the laptop fetched off the chain. Yes.
The laptop is destroyed, and its private state with it. No seed phrase brings it back.
steps.detail: identity secret: gone. Veto card: in the drawer.

steps.say: The new phone makes a one-time device key. Its fingerprint is what the guardians will check.
Seo-yeon opens a recovery of Hana's identity, for that device key. Opening needs no secret; the new phone has none to offer.
Seo-yeon compares the fingerprint with the one Hana reads to her over the phone, and approves.
Mum does the same. Quorum: two of two needed.
Each sends her share to the new phone, off chain.
An attacker reads the whole public ledger and tries every derivation it knows against Hana's guardian tree, starting from her real guardians' names.
Minji tries to approve Hana's recovery with her own guardian leaf. The leaf and its path are real — for a different identity.
steps.expect: refused: path does not bind to this guardian leaf
steps.message: path does not bind to this guardian leaf

steps.say: Seo-yeon tries to approve a second time.
Jihoon phishes Mum's share. With his own, that is two: he rebuilds Hana's identity secret, salt and all.
steps.detail: he now holds exactly what the lost laptop held

steps.say: He acts as Hana at the DApp. This is the honest cost of any recovery scheme: until her recovery finalizes, that secret IS the owner's.
He tries to mint a guardian token of his own, to fake a quorum.
steps.expect: refused: adding a guardian requires the veto secret
steps.message: adding a guardian requires the veto secret

steps.say: He opens a recovery for his own device. Anyone may.
He approves it with his real guardian token: one of the two it needs, and he cannot mint the second.
He tries to finalize Hana's recovery instead: it has a quorum, and he has the secret.
steps.expect: refused: not the device the guardians approved
steps.message: not the device the guardians approved

steps.say: He tries to evict the guardians, which would kill Hana's recovery.
steps.expect: refused: rotating the guardian set requires the veto secret
steps.message: rotating the guardian set requires the veto secret

steps.say: He tries to veto Hana's recovery.
steps.expect: refused: veto secret does not open this identity's veto commitment
steps.message: veto secret does not open this identity's veto commitment

steps.say: Hana sees a recovery she did not start, types her veto card into the phone, and kills it.
steps.payer: the sponsor (the device holds no wallet)

steps.say: His own recovery is dead.
But until Hana's recovery finalizes, the secret he holds is the owner's at the independent DApp too.
The phone rebuilds Hana's identity secret from the two shares, and makes a new identity to succeed it.
steps.detail: secret and salt rebuilt from shares alone

steps.say: Finalize now?
Wait out the timelock: 11 min 10 s.
steps.detail: waited 8 min 9 s of real time for the chain's block time to pass the timelock

steps.say: Meanwhile the committee seals its daily epoch. Hana's old commitment is still current: her recovery has not finalized.
Member 1 proposes that root as epoch 1.
Member 1 signs it. The circuit verifies the Jubjub Schnorr signature itself.
Member 2 signs it. The circuit verifies the Jubjub Schnorr signature itself.
Two of three: epoch 1 is sealed.
Suppose one share had been tampered with in transit. The rebuilt secret is wrong, and the chain can tell.
steps.expect: refused: reconstructed secret does not open idCommit
steps.message: reconstructed secret does not open idCommit

steps.say: The sponsor who pays for Hana's transactions tries to finalize for itself.
steps.expect: refused: not the device the guardians approved
steps.message: not the device the guardians approved

steps.say: The phone finalizes: the approved device, the right secret, after the timelock. The old commitment is retired and a successor takes its place.
steps.payer: the sponsor (the device holds no wallet)

steps.say: Jihoon tries the DApp again with the old secret.
steps.expect: refused: not the current owner of this identity root
steps.message: not the current owner of this identity root

steps.say: Hana's phone acts at the DApp. The DApp still stores the same single value — her identity root — and never had to change it.
steps.payer: the sponsor (the device holds no wallet)

steps.say: Anyone can prove the new commitment is the current head of Hana's root: descent is one Merkle membership proof, headship one non-membership check.
The same proof for the old commitment: it still descends from the root, but it is no longer the head.
And the phone proves it holds the head's secret, without revealing it.
steps.payer: the sponsor (the device holds no wallet)

steps.say: At the independent DApp, the old secret still works: epoch 1 was sealed before the recovery, and a snapshot can only say who owned what when it was sealed. This is the gap SECURITY.md bounds at 24 hours.
The committee's next epoch rebuilds the list from the ledger: Hana's old commitment is retired, her successor is current.
Member 1 proposes that root as epoch 2.
Member 1 signs it. The circuit verifies the Jubjub Schnorr signature itself.
Member 2 signs it. The circuit verifies the Jubjub Schnorr signature itself.
Two of three: epoch 2 is sealed.
Jihoon tries epoch 2 with his path from epoch 1.
steps.expect: refused: ownership leaf is not in the attested snapshot
steps.message: ownership leaf is not in the attested snapshot

steps.say: And epoch 1 again: it is no longer the latest.
Hana's phone passes at the independent DApp too. It never changed the value it stores either.
steps.payer: the sponsor (the device holds no wallet)

steps.say: Hana deals fresh shares of her new secret. The old shares rebuild a retired secret, so they are worthless.
With her new veto card she rotates the guardian set. Every old token is void — Jihoon's included.
steps.payer: the sponsor (the device holds no wallet)

steps.say: She adds Seo-yeon back, with a fresh token.
steps.payer: the sponsor (the device holds no wallet)

steps.say: She adds Mum back, with a fresh token.
steps.payer: the sponsor (the device holds no wallet)

steps.say: Committee member 3's signing key leaks. The committee is deliberately not sealed, so the other two can replace it.
Member 1 proposes the replacement.
Member 1 signs the rotation.
Member 2 signs the rotation.
Sealed: slot 3 has a new key, and the generation moves on, voiding every signature the leaked key ever made.
The committee seals epoch 3 under the new generation, with member 3's new key.
Member 1 proposes that root as epoch 3.
Member 2 signs it. The circuit verifies the Jubjub Schnorr signature itself.
Member 3 signs it. The circuit verifies the Jubjub Schnorr signature itself.
Whoever holds the leaked key tries to vote for epoch 3 in slot 3.
steps.expect: refused: public key does not match this committee slot
steps.message: public key does not match this committee slot

steps.say: Two of three: epoch 3 is sealed.
